name: Error-state Camera Optimization
definition: Parameterization of camera poses as rigid transformations from camera to world coordinates, optimized via an error-state correction in the tangent space of SE(3) to handle residual odometry errors.
summary: Error-state camera optimization refines poses and focal lengths by optimizing residual corrections in the tangent space of the SE(3) manifold, ensuring smoother convergence than direct manifold optimization.
